Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 2.1: Advantages and Disadvantages of Being Famous
Nội dung chi tiết:
Read the following statement:

"Many young people dream of becoming famous celebrities, influencers, or public figures, believing that fame brings great happiness and wealth, while others emphasize the significant drawbacks of living in the public eye."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the advantages and disadvantages of being famous. Include relevant examples and explanations from your knowledge or experience to support your points.
title: Task 2.1: Advantages and Disadvantages of Being Famous
content:
Read the following statement:

"Many young people dream of becoming famous celebrities, influencers, or public figures, believing that fame brings great happiness and wealth, while others emphasize the significant drawbacks of living in the public eye."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the advantages and disadvantages of being famous. Include relevant examples and explanations from your knowledge or experience to support your points.

body1.example: For instance, my brother was a talented young musician who struggled to cover his monthly living costs. Therefore, he decided to share his songs regularly on social media until one video went viral. As a result, he finally earned steady income from brand deals and even donated musical instruments to a local school. If he had not gained online fame, he would not have been able to achieve financial comfort and help others so easily.
body1.focus: Ưu điểm: Thu nhập cao, nhiều cơ hội nghề nghiệp và đóng góp cho từ thiện
body1.frame: Mở: On the one hand, being famous as a celebrity or influencer brings a lot of advantages in several ways | Ruột ĐOẠN 1 | Chốt: Clearly, these benefits make being famous as a celebrity or influencer appealing to many people.
body1.point: A very important point to consider is that being famous gives people more opportunities to earn high salaries from advertising, events, and brand deals. This means that successful celebrities can quickly improve their living standard and support their families financially. Another point I would like to make is that public figures can use their wide voice to make a contribution to charity and community projects. This is because of the fact that millions of fans follow their advice and are willing to join meaningful campaigns they promote.

body2.example: For example, I was curious about the exciting life of young influencers until I watched a documentary about a popular singer who could not even eat quietly with her family. For this reason, I got to see how harsh online comments and nonstop schedules made her feel lonely and exhausted. If I had not learned about that hidden side of fame, I would not have been able to know how stressful living without privacy truly is.
body2.focus: Nhược điểm: Mất quyền riêng tư, áp lực dư luận và khó cân bằng gia đình (Trục Peace & Privacy + Mini-essay #3)
body2.frame: Mở: On the other hand, the disadvantages of being famous as a celebrity or influencer are undeniable | Ruột ĐOẠN 2 | Chốt: It is clear that losing personal privacy and facing heavy public pressure can create serious drawbacks if ignored.
body2.point: In fact, living in the public eye takes away personal privacy because fans and cameras follow celebrities almost everywhere they go. This happens because when every small mistake is posted on social media, it easily leads to thousands of rude comments and heavy mental stress. In addition, tight filming and travel schedules make it very hard for famous people to reach a healthy balance between work and family time.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, being famous brings both pros and cons. While people can benefit from high income, career opportunities, and positive social influence, they also need to handle losing personal privacy and heavy public pressure. Therefore, both individuals and media platforms should work together to make the most of public fame responsibly.
